 from typing import Any
 
+from ringbuf.errors import BufferFull

 class RingBuffer:
-    """Placeholder: keeps everything it is given, in order."""
+    """Fixed-capacity buffer that keeps the most recent items."""
 
     def __init__(self, capacity: int, overwrite: bool = True) -> None:
-        self.capacity = capacity
+        if not isinstance(capacity, int) or capacity < 1:
+            raise ValueError
+        self._capacity = capacity
         self.overwrite = overwrite

+
+    @property
+    def capacity(self) -> int:
+        return self._capacity
+
+    @property
+    def full(self) -> bool:
+        return self._size == self._capacity
+
+    @property
+    def empty(self) -> bool:
+        return self._size == 0
 
     def push(self, item: Any) -> None:
-        self._items.append(item)
+        if self.full:
+            if not self.overwrite:
+                raise BufferFull
+            self._items[self._head] = item
+            self._head = (self._head + 1) % self._capacity
+        else:
+            idx = (self._head + self._size) % self._capacity
+            self._items[idx] = item
+            self._size += 1
+
+    def pop(self) -> Any:
+        if self.empty:
+            raise IndexError
+        item = self._items[self._head]
+        self._head
